runs.content: Salesforce (NYSE, $229.13) was bought as the day's momentum pick. It is up ~34% over 3 months, pulled back ~5% to its rising 50-day average, with Agentforce ARR above $1.5B and fresh analyst upgrades as tech rebounded. HPQ was exited on a thesis break (IDC Q3 PC shipments −31% YoY, FY27 guidance withheld) at +20.75%; blended with its T1 it closes at +$222 (+22.2%), the first winning close since July. No stop/T1/T2 triggers; RIGL is $1.25 from T1 and CVX is $5.53 from T1. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,914 (+2.52% on $76,000).

Fresnillo (LSE, FTSE 100, 2,689.00p ≈ $35.58) was bought as the day's value pick. It is a silver/gold miner at ~11.7x earnings with ~66% ROIC, ~40% below its January peak despite H1 revenue +75%, and was chosen as a precious-metals hedge on a day when an Iran-driven oil spike hit tech. DE was exited as a capacity trim (−5.49%, −$55; weakest position, momentum premise failed). No stop/T1/T2 triggers; RIGL is $1.61 from T1 and CVX is $5.96 from T1. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,583 (+2.11% on $75,000).
